point.title: 现在进行时
point.summary: 现在进行时表示此刻正在进行的动作,结构为 be(am/is/are)+ 动词的 -ing 形式,常与 now、Look!、Listen! 连用。现在分词拼写:一般直接加 -ing(read→reading);以不发音 e 结尾去 e 加 -ing(write→writing);重读闭音节双写末尾辅音字母(swim→swimming, sit→sitting)。否定在 be 后加 not;疑问把 be 提到句首。
point.examples: Look! The children are playing. / She is writing a letter. / What are you doing now?

questions.stem: Look! The children ____ playing football.
questions.explanation: 复数主语 children 用 are。

questions.stem: She ____ reading a book now.
questions.explanation: 单数主语用 is。

questions.stem: I ____ doing my homework.
questions.explanation: 主语 I 用 am。

questions.stem: Listen! Someone ____ singing.
questions.explanation: someone 视为单数,用 is。

questions.stem: They ____ swimming in the pool.
questions.explanation: 复数主语用 are。

questions.stem: He is ____ a picture now.
questions.explanation: 现在进行时用动词 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: Look, the dog ____ running fast.
questions.explanation: 单数主语 the dog 用 is。

questions.stem: We ____ cleaning the classroom.
questions.explanation: 复数主语 we 用 are。

questions.stem: My mother is ____ dinner in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 现在进行时用 cooking。

questions.stem: The boys are ____ in the river.
questions.explanation: swim 重读闭音节,双写 m 加 -ing。

questions.stem: Tom is ____ a letter to his friend.
questions.explanation: write 去掉不发音的 e 加 -ing。

questions.stem: Look! She is ____ a kite in the park.
questions.explanation: fly 直接加 -ing。

questions.stem: The cat is ____ on the chair.
questions.explanation: sit 重读闭音节,双写 t 加 -ing。

questions.stem: He ____ watching TV; he is reading a book.
questions.explanation: 现在进行时否定在 be 后加 not。

questions.stem: ____ you listening to me now?
questions.explanation: 现在进行时疑问把 be 提前,主语 you 用 Are。

questions.stem: What ____ they doing now?
questions.explanation: 复数主语 they 的进行时疑问用 are。

questions.stem: The students are ____ an English song.
questions.explanation: sing 直接加 -ing。

questions.stem: — What ____ your father ____ now? — He ____ washing the car.
questions.explanation: 进行时疑问 is + doing;简答 is washing。

questions.stem: Usually I ____ to school by bike, but look, today I ____ the bus.
questions.explanation: usually 用一般现在时 go;look/today 表此刻,用进行时 am taking。

questions.stem: Listen! The girls ____ dancing and the boy ____ singing.
questions.explanation: 复数 girls 用 are,单数 boy 用 is。
